$comment: THE OPEN-FINDINGS REGISTER — and it is not a waiver list.
The audit that produced `scripts/spec-contract.mjs` (WI-374 leg A) found real drift between
this kit, the published API spec, and the welcome pack. The instrument that DETECTS that drift
must not also be the thing that CURES it — a checker that edits the documents it grades proves
nothing, and the findings below have owners outside this repo. Landing the instrument red on
main would be worse still: a red that nobody can act on is background noise inside a week, and
a gate people have learned to ignore has already failed.
So every open finding is named, owned and DATED here, and the register is checked three ways on
• an entry past `expires` is RED — an unclosed gap becomes a decision, never a default;
• an entry whose finding NO LONGER REPRODUCES is RED — the entry must be deleted, which is how
this file empties itself and the check becomes fully enforcing;
• anything NOT listed here is RED immediately, with no grace at all.
The count is printed on every run and in the job summary. Silence is the failure mode this whole
instrument exists to prevent; this file is loud on purpose.
TO CLOSE A ROW: fix the finding, delete the entry, watch the check stay green.

gaps.owner: purple-site-kit maintainers (WI-374 leg A, row B1)
gaps.note: lib/purple/client.ts exports tenantSelf(), which calls an operation the public spec does not publish. Nothing in the kit calls it — it is dead code, which is exactly why it survived four integrator walks unnoticed. Cure is a decision, not an edit: either the platform publishes GET /tenants/self as public, or the accessor comes out of the kit.

gaps.note: the bundled quickstart SKILL points an agent at /catalog as the platform's source of truth for product surfaces. That operation is x-audience:internal and is not on the public surface — an integrator following the skill calls something it cannot reach.

Sibling row NEXT_PUBLIC_PURPLE_BRAND_ID passes because its demo default IS stated in the README; this one is the same class, uncured.

gaps.owner: docs/kit copy owner (Architect ruling C3, WI-374)
gaps.note: the entry-mode toggle is currently spelled four ways across the estate: funnelMode quiz-first|buy-first in kit code and README, questionnaire-first|direct-buy in AGENT-BRIEF.md, qualify-first|pay-first in the welcome pack the walk runner emits, and question-first|pay-first as the Architect-ruled PUBLIC pair. The code values are FROZEN (renaming breaks every fork), so the cure is one mapping sentence in the README — which is what this assertion demands.
